purpose: Choose the next blind 2015-2018 passes by causal information gain instead of filling every shard by quota.
inputs: promoted cross-shard bridge and satellite topology already present in coverage-index
decision_dimensions: ability to explain 2019-2020 Reality from decisions or expectations formed in 2015-2018
capital/project lead time and delayed supply response
importance to lithium price / effective supply / chemistry demand interpretation
current weakness of explicit pre-2019 causal setup
likelihood that the pass creates reusable cross-shard bridges rather than isolated trivia

priority.reason: Brine expansions, pond/residence-time physics, Atacama/Argentina contract regimes and slow project response are a necessary counterweight to the hard-rock story. They can explain why nominal resource/capacity signals before 2019 did not translate one-for-one into effective supply during the downturn.

Merchant spodumene concentrate pricing, offtake structures, quality/qualification and mine-to-converter bottlenecks connect upstream mine investment to chemical conversion and price transmission. This is central to reconstructing the 2017-2020 cycle rather than treating mine tonnes as immediately usable lithium supply.

Early stationary-storage economics, safety, policy and system-design expectations provide the antecedent for the later LFP second-demand-curve narrative. The value is structural, but its direct explanatory power for the 2019-2020 lithium downcycle is below the two upstream shards.

Pre-2019 recycling is useful for scrap-first economics, cobalt/nickel value drivers, policy roots and future secondary-supply expectations, but it is less likely than the first three shards to change the primary interpretation of the 2019-2020 lithium cycle.

Graphite feedstock, graphitization and qualification have long lead times and useful cross-chain structure, but current campaign topology does not yet indicate that missing 2015-2018 anode history is a first-order blocker for cycle replay.
Salt/solvent/additive history matters for cost and safety but is less likely to explain the principal 2019-2020 lithium balance without a stronger negative-space signal.
Capacity qualification and wet/dry process history can matter, but the current information-gain case for a dedicated pre-2019 pass is weaker than upstream supply and early storage demand.

Two-wheelers, tools and consumer applications are real demand components, yet a blanket pre-2019 pass risks collecting descriptive history rather than changing the causal interpretation of the benchmark cycle.

execution_rule.stop_rule: After each pass classify every lead as new_category, useful_refinement or duplicate. Stop widening the pre-2019 batch when useful new causal dimensions materially decay; do not continue merely to equalize shard counts.
execution_rule.recycling_rule: Run LOOP-RECYCLING only if the first three passes still show healthy marginal novelty or expose an unresolved secondary-supply / scrap-economics bridge.
execution_rule.search_boundary: No fresh web/search until the individual shard is sealed.

trigger_to_build: a sealed shard produces substantial claim-scoped verification workload
source-first archive-now collection develops a stable repeated bounded-web workload that becomes a real bottleneck
